entities.summary: Volodymyr Ivanovych Barvinok was a Ukrainian historian, theologist, bibliographer, writer, archaeologist, prominent archivist, statesman of the Ukrainian National Republic, honorary citizen of the Chernihiv region, scholar at the Ukrainian Academy of Science and teacher of Ukrainian culture and history.
